testcase.name: history renders the selected fixture without a repeated welcome
desktop sidebar collapses and expands with usable navigation
quick actions fill the composer without sending a request
IME composition and Shift+Enter never accidentally submit
page-local conversations survive navigation and stay isolated
API failures stay visible and never produce a fake assistant reply
stopping and opening a different conversation cannot mix late responses
account links show unknown balance and retain all personal pages
mobile drawer traps focus and Escape restores its opener
mobile visual viewport resizing keeps the composer above the keyboard
all routes render and home clearly labels demo content
community filters demo posts and unfinished publishing is explicit
real local SSE reaches the page and remains mock
login reports 501 and does not create an authenticated state
mobile navigation and layouts fit a 390px viewport
first visit has no history, no recommendation, and the gentle composer copy
consent without an actual conversation never invents a topic
loading clearly fictional history does not implicitly grant consent
authorized latest topic shows traceable mock content and timestamp on desktop
continue reopens the original conversation without duplicate messages or requests
temporarily dismissing a topic stays dismissed through navigation
turning recommendations off prevents them after a new conversation too
deleted topics are never recommended or silently reloaded
deleting an open conversation returns home and its old route becomes unavailable
earlier history remains selectable and opening it does not change the latest topic
switching preview identities clears history and consent and blocks the old route
local summaries use actual excerpts, including happy conversations
switching visitors removes local text as well as mock fixtures
refresh resets consent and does not pretend to persist restored history
mobile card remains light, resumes correctly and supports deletion in the drawer
a 320px screen and a resized visual viewport keep input usable
switching visitors cancels in-flight replies and cannot repopulate the new visitor
a shorter desktop keeps the welcome visible and composer pinned
